directActualProbeBindings.rule: Exact inner execution pid and argv for probe Python; direct parent pid plus process startTicks bind Node to that Python and Chrome to that Node, observed live.

scope: One unchanged scoped probe with actual live process bytes, not full CDP/Windows/golden. The inner original gate and probe are not modified.

publicProjection.changes: Machine/executable/isolated source, feedback and profile path labels; colliding absolute-path dictionary keys retain basename and original-key SHA256, preserving all entries. Result, full SHA, dirty, command, exit and original hashes remain.

dictionaryKeyAudit.rule: Colliding public path keys retain basename plus full SHA256 of original key; values retained one-to-one
